'''Zhai Zhonghe''' ({{zh|c=翟中和|p=Zhái Zhōnghé}}; 18 August 1930 – 10 February 2023) was a Chinese cell biologist, and [[academician]] of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. He was a member of the [[Chinese Communist Party]].<ref name="CB">{{cite news |url=https://new.qq.com/rain/a/20230212A029Y300 |script-title=zh:翟中和院士逝世 |work=qq.com |date=12 February 2023 |access-date=12 February 2023 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
Zhai was born in [[Liyang|Liyang County]] (now Liyang), [[Jiangsu]], on 18 August 1930.<ref name="Ap">{{cite news|author1=Jiang Ziwen ({{lang|zh|蒋子文}}) |url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_21892663 |script-title=zh:细胞生物学家、中科院院士翟中和逝世，享年93岁 |work=thepaper |date=11 February 2023 |access-date=12 February 2023 |language=zh}}</ref> His mother died when he was 8, and he was raised by his paternal grandmother.<ref name="Li">{{cite news |author1=Zhang Shuo ({{lang|zh|张硕}}) |url=http://www.mmcs.org.cn/GZNEW/newslist/2017-04/152858.shtml |script-title=zh:记我国著名细胞生物学家翟中和院士 |work=mmcs.org.cn |date=27 April 2017 |access-date=12 February 2023 |language=zh |archive-date=12 February 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230212112834/http://www.mmcs.org.cn/GZNEW/newslist/2017-04/152858.shtml |url-status=dead }}</ref> He secondary studied at Jiangsu Provincial Liyang High School ({{zh|s=江苏省立溧阳中学|labels=no}}).<ref name="Li"/> In 1950, he was admitted to [[Tsinghua University]], where he majored in [[biology]].<ref name="Ap"/><ref name="Li"/> A year later, he was sent to study at the [[Saint Petersburg State University|University of Leningrad]] (now Saint Petersburg State University) on government scholarships.<ref name="Ap"/><ref name="Li"/>

Zhai returned to China in 1956 and that same year became a professor at the Department of Biology, [[Peking University]].<ref name="Ap"/><ref name="Li"/> In 1959, he pursued advanced studies at the Institute of Biophysics of the [[Academy of Sciences of the Soviet Union|Soviet Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="Li"/> He returned to China in 1961 and continued to teach at Peking University.<ref name="Li"/> In 1969, during the [[Cultural Revolution]], he was sent to the [[May Seventh Cadre Schools]] to do farm work in the suburb of [[Nanchang]], [[Jiangxi]], and returned to Peking University in 1973.<ref name="Li"/> He was a visiting scholar at [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] from 1985 to 1986, studying nuclear skeleton and its relationship with gene expression under the supervision of [[Sheldon Penman]].<ref name="Li"/>

Zhai died in [[Beijing]] on 10 February 2023, at the age of 92.<ref name="Ap"/><ref name="CB"/>

==Honours and awards==
* 1991 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref name="Ap"/>
* 1995 Science and Technology Progress Award of the [[Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation]]
